items.about:
Most brands have a powerful story. Few have the right team to tell it.
 
If you're a brand, agency, broadcaster or organisation operating across Southeast Asia, you already know the challenge producing video content that is clear, consistent and commercially effective across multiple markets is harder than it looks.
 
That's exactly the problem I've spent my career solving.
 
As founder of Picture Perfect Productions, I partner with clients across Vietnam, Singapore and Southeast Asia to create story-driven video content that cuts through, connects with audiences and delivers real business results.
 
Here's what we bring to every project:
 
Strategy, storytelling and production combined, not siloed 

International broadcast experience paired with on the ground Asia teams Culturally relevant content that works across borders 

Reliable, consistent execution whether you need one film or a full campaign
 
We specialise in branded content, corporate films, documentaries, digital campaigns and cross-border production support.
 
Production presence across the region: Singapore · Vietnam · Thailand · South Korea · India · Australia · New Zealand · Hong Kong · China
 
Every project is a new creative challenge — and that energy drives everything we do. When your story is told with clarity and craft, audiences engage, brands grow and business goals get met.
 
Your story deserves to be told well. Let's talk.

items.about:
I have spent 30 years in sports, media and marketing and doing a few other bits and pieces. With a passion for sports and not wanting to get a proper job I set out to build a sports TV distribution company from a barn in 1995, on that journey i saw the gap for The Extreme Sports Channel. Found some fantastic people to back us, (Thank you Mark Schneider) raised significant capital, launched the channel across 68 countries, built a global brand reaching 100 million subscribers before successfully exiting to Liberty Global. Since then, my focus has been on where audiences have moved to: social platforms, creators, communities and live events. We work with brands, athletes, creators, destinations and sports organisations who understand that the media and marketing landscape has shifted and changed.

Today alongside an incredible team I am building 𝐖𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡, a Media, Marketing and Talent Management Company. 

We specialise in sports, health, fitness, automotive and adventure travel and work with partners to deliver high impact marketing campaigns through strategic athlete and creator partnerships, social stunts and events, video production and social media reach.  

We represent a portfolio of athletes, social publishers, events and creators that combined, have an audience of 320+ million followers and deliver a reach of 950+ million people per month across Instagram, YouTube, Tik Tok, Snapchat and Facebook. ​​ 

Trusted by Leading brands: We have the privilege of working with top tier marketing teams and delivering campaigns for Red Bull, Google, Stanley Black & Decker, TripAdvisor, Swatch, Clarks, Knoops, Visit Malta, Qiddiya, ITV, PIF, WWF and Egypt Tourism.

For Creators & Athletes: We not only partner with leading talent helping them monetize their reach through strategic brand partnerships, IP development and off-platform revenue, we also offer creators, athletes & agencies who join us a share in the equity and long-term value we are building. 

𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺 To build Wavelength we have assembled a brilliant team from Spotify, Universal Music , YT, Meta & McCann united by the ambition to build a next generation media company. I am also the founder of Extreme International, part of Wavelength, The Extreme Hangout, a climate events platform and board member & investor in a number of start ups.  On the personal front i am a passionate skier, sailor, private pilot, dive master, padel player and environmentalist.

So if you’re a brand, athlete, sports organisation, destination or creator looking to win — we would love to talk!

items.about:
After taking voluntary retirement in April 2010, I embarked on a journey to pursue my lifelong passion: personal finance. Throughout my years in the Indian Armed Forces, I was deeply drawn to financial planning and had the privilege of advising countless officers and colleagues. However, I often observed a disconnect - despite their fairly good salaries and status, many armed forces personnel and their families struggled to achieve the financial security and prosperity they deserved. This realisation ignited my determination to make a difference.

Even with my promotion to Brigadier approved in February 2010, I chose to take voluntary retirement and follow my dream of addressing this financial gap. Hum Fauji Initiatives was born out of this vision - a personal finance company (Corporate Registered Investment Advisor) uniquely dedicated to enhancing the financial wellness of India’s armed forces personnel and their families across the globe. Today, as CEO, I am proud to lead a truly iconic and award-winning organization that transforms lives through expert financial planning and guidance. It is really a mission dedicated to enhancing the financial well-being of Indian armed forces personnel and their families, both in India and globally.

In addition to being a Certified Financial Planner (CFP), my academic pursuits include a thesis on the personal financial management of Indian Army officers during my Master of Management Sciences. My passion for financial literacy extends to my contributions to leading publications like Economic Times, Business Today, Outlook Money, and Financial Express.

Technology is another passion I continue to nurture. With a B.Tech in Electronics and an M.Tech in Electromagnetics from IIT Kanpur, I constantly seek innovative ways to integrate technology into financial planning, ensuring our clients benefit from cutting-edge solutions.

I am deeply committed to transforming the financial landscape for those who serve our nation. Let’s connect to explore how strategic financial planning can create lasting impact.

publications.title: The Big Sister's Guide to the World of Work: The Inside Rules Every Girl Must Know
publications.description: For those obsessing about whether or not their boss hates them, DiFalco and Herz dispense a little sisterly advice—she probably does. But as brutally frank as the self-appointed "Big Sisters" can be in confirming readers’ worst fears, the duo are also fabulous at explaining exactly what to do to change the situation or, at least, what to do to change the bad habits that created the sticky mess in the first place. The authors—both former Hachette Filipacchi executives who’ve mentored hundreds of professional women—offer a compendium of all the things women do to sabotage their careers along with excellent advice on how to stop, move on and move up. They do so without pity and with more than a bit of self-deprecating humor. Best of all, they stay well clear of the holier-than-thou self-help pulpit. Their advice ranges from tips on how to overcome a genetic aversion to networking (which they liken to the equally common aversion to exercise) to suggestions on how to vanquish the fear of public speaking. Their tutorial on successful interviewing includes links to the questions human resource interviewers ask, so readers can prepare for them accordingly. DiFalco and Herz sum up the need for taking charge of one’s professional destiny by comparing it to choosing between the starring roles in a production of "Thelma & Her Career." Either you chose to be the driver or the helpless passenger. Unflinching with their reality checks, DiFalco and Herz are also generous with their insights and with their practical advice for moving through one’s professional life successfully. No big deal really; that’s what sisters are for.
